component.name: Timblee Pad
component.summary: Lightweight source editor for HTML, CSS and XML

description.p: Timblee Pad is a lightweight standalone editor for HTML, CSS and XML source files.
It provides language-aware highlighting and editing, an insertion Library, editable document templates, and localhost browser preview without an embedded browser engine.
Corrects the locked public source-root README filename to README.md and updates packaging/source-tree validation accordingly.

Matches Sheepy Pad editor scrolling behavior by disabling global center-on-scroll while preserving explicit Go To Line centering, and keeps the line-number gutter above a visible horizontal scrollbar.
Adds the locked public root README and updates packaging/source-tree validation for the new root-level release file.
Standardizes the portable/AppImage packaging contract for Suite Pythoine and updates the Pad-family slogan, with application behavior otherwise unchanged.
Experimental HTML/CSS/XML document profiles, startup document chooser/defaults, editable templates, language-aware Library, simplified split/sidebar layout, and localhost browser preview.
Promotes Timblee Pad to 0.1.0 with hardened AppImage QA, including real default/dark/light/system GUI theme smoke checks for both AppDir and final AppImage.
Initial Timblee Pad release, derived from Sheepy Pad 0.0.1-r19 and purpose-built for HTML and CSS source editing.
